goal: Trace the lineage of LoRA (low-rank adaptation of large language models): the parameter-efficient fine-tuning ideas it built on and the significant follow-ups that improved it.

definitions.LoRA: Freezes pretrained weights and learns low-rank update matrices.
definitions.parameter-efficient fine-tuning: Adapting a large model by training a small fraction of parameters.
definitions.rank: Dimensionality of the learned update factorization.
